100 Years Ago Today, This is What Was Happening ...

On August 30, 1926, a significant earthquake struck the city of Tiflis, Georgia, causing widespread damage and prompting urgent relief efforts. Meanwhile, in the United States, the ongoing labor unrest in the coal mining industry continued to escalate, with striking miners demanding better wages and working conditions. Additionally, the British government faced mounting pressure regarding its policies in India as nationalist movements gained momentum.
